otherWay.text: Owner cash in the latest 12 months was 23.4% of revenue, above the 3.0% line.
Capital spending was 2.3 times stock pay. The shortfall is mostly investment, not stock pay.
The company paid $76.8 billion to buy back shares and $47.1 billion in dividends over the period.
Operating costs fell from 45.8% of revenue in 2021 to 42.5% in 2025.

summary: From fiscal 2007 to 2025, Amgen Inc. reported $421.8 billion of revenue and $145.5 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $6.8 billion, which leaves $138.8 billion of owner cash: 32.9% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 0 of 19 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-09-30 it was 23.4% of revenue.
